# Task 12 Report: Frontend App Shell, Hero, ModelPicker

## Status
Complete. All changes implemented, tested, typechecked, and linted.

## Commits

## Changes
- `apps/studio/src/App.tsx` — wrapped `StudioShell`/`OnboardingProvider` in `StudioRuntimeProvider` (from `./assistant/StudioRuntime`) so the assistant-ui runtime (`AssistantRuntimeProvider`) is available to `Hero` via `useAuiState`.
- `apps/studio/src/components/chat/Hero.tsx` — ported to runtime-driven suggestions: reads `state.thread.suggestions` via `useAuiState`, renders each suggestion as a conversational pill (title + description) that calls `sendMessage(suggestion.prompt)`; keeps greeting rotation; non-conversational "Opportunity landscape" / "Capture" fallback pill; quiet "Edit context" setup button.
- `apps/studio/src/components/chat/ModelPicker.tsx` — rewrote (~300 lines): fetch models from `/api/models` via `studioApi.fetchModels`, probe-per-backend+key caching (`loadedFor`), keyboard nav (ArrowDown/Up/Home/End/Enter/Space/Escape/Tab), focus management, dismissal on outside click, offline UX derived from `llmHealth`, configured model always offered and marked "Current", "Model settings" button opens the Settings panel when the backend reports none/unreachable.
- `apps/studio/src/components/chat/ModelPicker.test.tsx` — new (7 tests): listing + current-model mark, save chosen model + close, arrow keys + Enter select, Escape closes + returns focus, configured model selectable when backend omits it, unreachable backend explains via Settings path, one probe per backend not per open.
- `apps/studio/src/components/chat/ChatStage.tsx` — `<Hero onSubmit={...} />` → `<Hero />` (Hero now takes no props; uses `sendMessage` from `useStudio` internally).
- `apps/studio/src/components/chat/ThreadComposer.tsx` — `<ModelPicker offline={...} />` → `<ModelPicker />` (offline derived internally).
- `apps/studio/src/test/setup.ts` — added jsdom `ResizeObserver` no-op stub required by the assistant-ui viewport primitives.
- `apps/studio/src/App.test.tsx` — ported from feature branch: mocks `studioApi`, renders `<App />` under `StudioRuntimeProvider`; adds suggestion assertions ("Turn a hunch into something defensible", "Look across what you already know", "sharpen an opportunity" button), a "sends the runtime prompt when a contextual starter card is selected" test (asserts `streamChat` called with the sharpen prompt + `AbortSignal`), and asserts the starter pills leave the DOM once a message is sent.

## Test Summary
- `npm --prefix apps/studio test -- --run` → **33 files passed, 307 tests passed**.
- `App.test.tsx`: 17 tests pass (was failing before due to missing `AuiProvider`; now renders under `StudioRuntimeProvider`). Key assertions: greeting heading, suggestion pills render and are clickable, clicking "sharpen an opportunity" issues `streamChat` with the runtime prompt and an `AbortSignal`, pills disappear after a message is sent, workspace landscape opens/closes beside the composer, slash commands, offline mode, first-run tour, first-run context conversation.
- `ModelPicker.test.tsx`: 8 tests pass.

## Typecheck / Lint
- `npm --prefix apps/studio run typecheck` → clean (`tsc -b --noEmit`, no output).
- `npm --prefix apps/studio run lint` → 0 errors; 1 pre-existing warning in `composerParts.tsx` (`react-refresh/only-export-components`), unrelated to this task.

## Concerns
- `ResizeObserver` polyfill added to shared `setup.ts` because jsdom lacks it and the assistant-ui runtime subscribes to viewport resize; scoped as a no-op stub, low risk.
- `ModelPicker.test.tsx` mocks `useStudio` and `studioApi` wholesale via `vi.mock`, so it does not exercise the real `StudioContext`/`fetchModels` integration — consistent with the reference port.
- `Hero` depends on `AssistantRuntimeProvider` context provided by `StudioRuntimeProvider`; if `App` is ever rendered without it, `useAuiState` would throw. `App.tsx` now guarantees the wrapper.
